name: Michael Grier
title: Software developer
summary: Full-stack software developer with five years at TransAlta building renewable-energy reporting tools and business process automation. Co-led a reporting and data-governance platform and maintained a wind, solar, and hydro operations app, working across React interfaces, APIs, databases, and Azure infrastructure. Independent projects include ecommerce, a native mobile app, and browser-based developer tools.

products.name: AthenaOS
bullets: Co-led development of a Next.js and TypeScript platform that lets SQL-fluent analysts assemble wind and hydro reporting dashboards without writing React.
Built reusable ECharts cards and chart presets, plus a data-catalog workflow with draft submissions, multi-stage review, rework, and audit trails.
Implemented Microsoft Entra ID SSO, PostgreSQL-backed sessions, and distributed locking for token refresh across application instances.
Built Terraform and GitHub Actions delivery workflows across development, UAT, and production, including release promotion, hotfixes, and rollback.

products.name: GenOS
bullets: Migrated event data from REST to GraphQL and replaced a 1,700-line shared React component with focused wind, solar, and hydro modules.
Built reusable mobile and tablet modals for event details and monitoring graphs; established Docker builds and Azure Pipelines across three environments.
Fixed SQL Server connection leaks and strengthened JWT verification. Corrected capacity values, event filtering, and multi-unit CSV exports used in NERC reporting.

experience.title: Junior Automation Developer
bullets: Developed and maintained Blue Prism automations, from stakeholder requirements and reusable process components to testing, scheduled execution, and troubleshooting deployed bots.

experience.title: Freelance Software Developer
bullets: Led frontend design and development for a Django web project and supported Unity mobile game development.

experience.title: Frontend Web Developer Intern
bullets: Built a React application connected to a REST API and NoSQL database, giving employees a web interface for data entry and retrieval.

projects.name: Skateboard Ecommerce Platform
projects.description: Checkout, inventory, and order management for an independent skateboard brand
projects.stack: Next.js, Stripe, Neon PostgreSQL, Drizzle, Cloudflare R2, Playwright
projects.bullet: Built checkout with server-validated pricing and atomic inventory reservations, retry-safe payment processing, and order management. Added end-to-end tests for price tampering, duplicate payments, and stock release.

projects.name: YYC Skate Spots
projects.stack: React Native, Expo, Convex, Clerk, Google Maps, EAS
projects.bullet: Built a mobile spot book with map clustering, location filters, photo submissions, favourites, and moderation. Added share links with a web fallback and prepared the iOS release configuration and store submission.

projects.name: Code Trainer
projects.stack: React, Vite, Monaco Editor, Web Workers, Convex, Better Auth, Vitest
projects.bullet: Built a browser-based coding workspace with isolated execution, TypeScript checking, and automated grading. Combined lessons and exercises with local guest progress and account-based synchronization across devices.
